final:
title_of(html: str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() <= html.char_count()
  ex title_of("<html><title>Hi</title></html>") == "Hi"
  ex title_of("<title></title>") == ""
  ex title_of("no title here") == ""
  ex title_of("<title>unclosed") == ""
  let parts = html.split("<title>")
  if parts.len() < 2
    return ""
  let rest = copy parts[1]
  let ends = rest.split("</title>")
  if ends.len() < 2
    return ""
  copy ends[0]
